name: sourceId
label: Sys ID
description: Sys ID of the source table

name: variablesLayout
label: Variables layout
description: Layout object of variables of item

name: readOnlyOption
label: Readonly Option
description: When the property is set to Printable, If the variable is read-only, then it is not editable

name: renderStyle
label: Variables render style
description: This property can be used to render variables with half width except HTML, Macros etc. in Compact mode.

name: variableGap
label: Variable gap
description: This property is used to define the gap between variables.

name: labelWrappingLimit
label: Label wrapping limit (px)
description: Wraps the label instead of truncating it if the container width is less than the limit specified
